newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank repo average yield falls to 17.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank repo average yield falls to 17.25 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Monday fell to 17.25 percent from 18.78 percent on Friday, the NBS said in a statement.
The central bank offered a fixed volume of 6.0 billion crowns with overall bids totalling 9.615 billion crowns.
The maximum accepted yield hit 19.55 percent while the minimum yield was 14.00 percent. Minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate.
The NBS added 3.5 billion crowns to the local money market through a three-day repo tender on Friday with average yield rising to 18.78 percent, from 18.60 percent on Thursday.
The NBS monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 13 lacked some 0.42 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 15.
